verdict.rationale: Consensus publishes a first-party pricing document (/.well-known/pricing.md) listing plan features such as Deep Searches and team-level centralized billing, so a researcher has an official place to review plans before committing. The quoted excerpts do not show actual prices, per-plan quotas, or usage caps. missing for 10: concrete plan prices, explicit usage limits/quotas per tier (e.g. Deep Search counts), free-vs-paid comparison, independent or hands-on confirmation of limits.
